summary.text: Vickie Paladino represents the 19th District on the New York City Council in Northeast Queens, which includes Whitestone, College Point, Bayside, Little Neck, Douglaston and parts of North Flushing.
Her Council biography says she was elected in 2021 and appointed Minority Whip in 2025.

paragraphs.text: Paladino was born in Whitestone to working-class parents, according to her Council biography, and her father, a World War II veteran, died when she was six.
Before entering politics she spent nearly 40 years raising a family and running two small businesses in the district.
Her stated legislative priorities are public safety and support for the NYPD, quality of life, education, small business support and government accountability.
